title: Error(string) revert
summary: Standard Solidity revert reason. Selector 0x08c379a0 encodes a single string argument — the reason text.
nextSteps: Read the decoded reason string — it usually pinpoints the cause directly.

title: Panic(0x11): arithmetic overflow / underflow
summary: Solidity 0.8+ inserts overflow checks. Adding past uint256.max or subtracting below 0 panics with code 0x11.
likelyCauses: Subtracting a larger number from a smaller one.
nextSteps: Add explicit guards (e.g. require(a >= b)) or use SafeCast.
If intentional, wrap in `unchecked { ... }` and document why.

title: Panic(0x01): assert(false)
likelyCauses: The contract hit the Solidity panic condition: assert(false).
nextSteps: Decode the full revert data and inspect the failing source line with a trace.
Add an explicit guard or custom error before this condition if user-triggerable.

title: Panic(0x22): bad storage byte array encoding

title: Panic(0x12): division or modulo by zero
summary: A `/` or `%` operation had a zero denominator.
nextSteps: Guard with require(d != 0).
Handle empty-state initialization explicitly.

title: Panic(0x32): array index out of bounds
summary: Accessed an array index that does not exist.
likelyCauses: Reading from an empty dynamic array.
Misindexed view function in the front-end.
nextSteps: Check `arr.length` before access.
Add bounds asserts in the front-end too.
